name: Falling lights
desc: Now and then a light rig crashes down on someone, either side: 3 damage.

name: Slippery canvas
desc: Run-in moves may slip: the attacker goes down, takes 1 and the move misses.

name: Burning ropes
desc: Jumping off the ropes burns: every aerial move costs its user 1 HP.

name: Spotlight
desc: Each round one fighter, either side, stands in the spotlight and hits 1 harder.
